system.summary: Throckmorton's cipher (first/second on R9260, third on R9262); which one is not testable without images. The contemporary R9220 letters use the third.
system.notes: DECODE marks graphic signs; no ciphertext seen.

prior_solution.where: CSP Foreign ii nos. 706, 751 (1865), "portions in cipher, deciphered"; Forbes, A Full View of the Public Transactions in the Reign of Q. Elizabeth, vol. I (London 1740), pp. 324-25, 328

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched DECODE R3026 with the shared cookie: no image or document files attached (Tomokiyo note: images should be uploaded).
Placed ff.100-101 before f.110 (R9220, 7-8 Mar 1560); grepped the Forbes Full View i OCR for February 1559/60: letters to Cecil 8 Feb (pp.324-25) and to the Council, Blois 20 Feb (p.328).
CSP Foreign ii nos. 706 and 751 describe both as originals with portions in cipher, deciphered; no. 751 cites Forbes i 328.

Looked for images of ff.100-101 elsewhere: no other DECODE record in records.json covers them (R2989 f.33, R9220 f.110), and the BL catalogue record 040-002109587 (Forbes Papers V) has no digitised content.

outcome.method_basis: Both letters are printed with the ciphered passages deciphered in Forbes, Full View i (1740) pp. 324-25 and 328, and calendared in CSP Foreign ii nos. 706 and 751.
outcome.notes: Read at the time and printed by Forbes 1740; ciphertext not seen (no images). Catalogue entry 96 removed, no write-up.
